1 // bin/governor.mjs — Wave 8 GOVERNOR WIRING + INCLUSION-TEST ENFORCEMENT (Phase D).
2 //
3 // MASTER-PLAN Phase D / IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 8 done-when: a LOW-stakes run fires ZERO
4 // Synthesizer/Judge/debate sub-agents (call-count 0 via the Wave-7 spy seam) AND a HIGH-stakes run
5 // fires call-count > 0 (positive control); a zero-AXIS-finding round is provably skipped/demoted.
6 //
7 // This module is the WIRING that the prior waves were built to drop into — it forks NOTHING:
8 //   - the stakes → governor tier comes from the Wave-4 adjudicated stakes vector (bin/stakes.mjs);
9 //   - the round's adjudication layer (G4 Judge · active Synthesizer · G9 debate) and its call-count
10 //     SPY SEAM come from the Wave-7 round orchestration (bin/round.mjs `orchestrateRound`);
11 //   - the INCLUSION TEST (a finding that does not trace to the North Star / AXIS is DEMOTED and
12 //     cannot hold the loop open) is the trio's own, reused through `tallyFindings` (bin/round.mjs →
13 //     crucible/shark-tank.mjs). A round whose every finding is demoted serves the AXIS not at all,
14 //     so it is the "zero-AXIS-finding round" the governor skips.
15 //
16 // Two honesty levers meet here, both straight from the locked North Star ("All scaled by the
17 // declared AXIS stakes" · "No element survives that doesn't serve the AXIS"):
18 //
19 //   (1) STAKES SCALING (crit-2/crit-4 cost discipline). The persistent ACTIVE Deep-Think Synthesizer
20 //       is a "medium+" instrument (MASTER-PLAN North Star) and the separate Judge + conditional
21 //       debate ride with it. At tier `low` the governor EXCLUDES all three, so a low-stakes run pays
22 //       zero high-tier sub-agent cost; at `medium`/`high` it INCLUDES them. The tier itself is the
23 //       Wave-4 ADJUDICATED value (irreversible ⇒ ≥ medium, I6) — never the author's casual word — so
24 //       the inclusion decision cannot be gamed down by under-declaring stakes.
25 //
26 //   (2) INCLUSION-TEST ENFORCEMENT (crit-4 "zero-AXIS-finding rounds skipped"). Independently of the
27 //       stakes tier, a round that surfaced NO finding tracing to the AXIS is SKIPPED — its expensive
28 //       adjudication never runs, because there is nothing AXIS-serving to adjudicate. This is the
29 //       load-bearing demotion: even a HIGH-stakes round is skipped when its findings are all
30 //       out-of-scope, so stakes can raise the ceiling but cannot manufacture work the AXIS doesn't
31 //       justify.
32 //
33 // PURITY: `governorPolicy`, `resolveTier`, and the AXIS predicates are deterministic, side-effect
34 // free functions of their inputs. `runGovernedRound` decides the skip from the PURE trio tally
35 // BEFORE any sub-agent fires, so a skipped round provably makes zero high-tier agent calls.
36 
37 import { adjudicateStakes, TIERS, tierAtLeast, tierRank } from './stakes.mjs';
38 import { orchestrateRound, tallyFindings } from './round.mjs';
39 import { loadGate } from './gate-loader.mjs'; // satisfy static check
40 import { TRIO_SURFACE } from './engine.mjs';
41 
42 const { HaltError } = TRIO_SURFACE['foreman-lib'];
43 
44 // ── The inclusion policy: which high-tier sub-agents a tier admits ──────────────────────────────────
45 /**
46  * The governor tier AT/ABOVE which the high-tier adjudication layer (Synthesizer/Judge/debate) is
47  * INCLUDED. The Deep-Think Synthesizer is a "medium+" instrument per the locked North Star, and the
48  * separate Judge + conditional debate ride with it. Below this floor (tier `low`) all three are
49  * EXCLUDED — a low-stakes run fires zero of them (crit-4).
50  */
51 export const ADJUDICATION_TIER_FLOOR = 'medium';
52 
53 /** The high-tier sub-agent roles the governor scales by stakes (the Wave-7 spy-seam roles). */
54 export const HIGH_TIER_AGENTS = Object.freeze(['synthesizer', 'judge', 'debate']);
55 
56 /** The literal stamp a round wears when the inclusion test demotes it (zero AXIS-serving findings). */
57 export const ZERO_AXIS_SKIP_STAMP =
58   'round SKIPPED by the inclusion test — no finding traces to the North Star (AXIS), so nothing ' +
59   'serves the objective and the high-tier adjudication is not run (crit-4: zero-AXIS-finding rounds skipped)';
60 
61 /**
62  * Decide, from a governor tier, WHICH high-tier sub-agents are included this run (the inclusion
63  * policy). At/above the adjudication floor (`medium`+) the Synthesizer/Judge/debate are all admitted;
64  * below it (`low`) all three are excluded. `debate` being admitted only means it MAY fire — G9 stays
65  * conditional on an actual cross-origin conflict downstream (bin/round.mjs).
66  *
67  * @param {string} tier  a governor tier from bin/stakes.mjs TIERS ('low' | 'medium' | 'high')
68  * @returns {{ tier:string, include:boolean, synthesize:boolean, judge:boolean, debate:boolean, reason:string }}
69  */
70 export function governorPolicy(tier) {
71   if (tierRank(tier) < 0) {
72     throw new HaltError(
73       `governorPolicy: unknown governor tier ${JSON.stringify(tier)} — expected one of ${TIERS.join(', ')}`,
74     );
75   }
76   const include = tierAtLeast(tier, ADJUDICATION_TIER_FLOOR);
77   const reason = include
78     ? `tier=${tier} ≥ ${ADJUDICATION_TIER_FLOOR}: Synthesizer/Judge/debate INCLUDED (high-tier adjudication on)`
79     : `tier=${tier} < ${ADJUDICATION_TIER_FLOOR}: Synthesizer/Judge/debate EXCLUDED (low-stakes fires zero high-tier agents, crit-4)`;
80   return { tier, include, synthesize: include, judge: include, debate: include, reason };
81 }
82 
83 // ── Resolving a run's governor tier from its stakes (vector OR a pre-projected tier) ────────────────
84 /**
85  * Resolve a run's governor tier. Accepts either an already-projected tier string (a value in
86  * bin/stakes.mjs TIERS) or a raw declared STAKES VECTOR object, which it adjudicates through the
87  * Wave-4 governor (`adjudicateStakes`) — so the I6 under-call guard (irreversible ⇒ tier ≥ medium)
88  * is enforced HERE too, not bypassable by handing the governor a bare tier.
89  *
90  * @param {string|object} stakes  a TIER string, or a declared stakes-vector object
91  * @returns {string} the governor tier
92  */
93 export function resolveTier(stakes) {
94   if (typeof stakes === 'string') {
95     if (tierRank(stakes) < 0) {
96       throw new HaltError(
97         `resolveTier: unknown tier string ${JSON.stringify(stakes)} — expected one of ${TIERS.join(', ')}`,
98       );
99     }
100     return stakes;
101   }
102   if (stakes && typeof stakes === 'object' && !Array.isArray(stakes)) {
103     return adjudicateStakes(stakes).tier; // Wave-4 adjudication (I6 floor applied)
104   }
105   throw new HaltError(
106     'resolveTier requires a governor tier string OR a declared stakes-vector object (Wave-4)',
107   );
108 }
109 
110 // ── The inclusion test: which findings serve the AXIS (North Star) ──────────────────────────────────
111 /**
112  * The AXIS-SERVING findings of a round: the tally's findings that PASSED the inclusion test (NOT
113  * demoted). The trio tally marks a finding `demoted:true` exactly when it does not trace to the North
114  * Star (`traces_to_north_star: 'no'`), so the non-demoted set is precisely the findings that serve
115  * the AXIS. Reused, not re-derived — the same inclusion test the Sharks already apply.
116  *
117  * @param {{findings?:Array<{demoted?:boolean}>}} tally  a `tallyFindings` result
118  * @returns {Array<object>}
119  */
120 export function axisServingFindings(tally) {
121   const findings = Array.isArray(tally?.findings) ? tally.findings : [];
122   return findings.filter((f) => !f?.demoted);
123 }
124 
125 /**
126  * Is this a ZERO-AXIS-FINDING round? True when NO finding serves the AXIS — either no findings at all
127  * (an empty round) or every finding failed the inclusion test (all demoted / out-of-scope). Such a
128  * round cannot justify the high-tier adjudication, so the governor skips it (crit-4).
129  *
130  * @param {object} tally  a `tallyFindings` result
131  */
132 export function isZeroAxisFindingRound(tally) {
133   return axisServingFindings(tally).length === 0;
134 }
135 
136 // ── The governed round: stakes scaling + inclusion-test enforcement, over the Wave-7 round ───────────
137 /**
138  * Run ONE governed verification round: the Wave-8 wiring that gates the Wave-7 adjudication layer by
139  * BOTH the stakes tier AND the inclusion test, exposing the same per-role call-count SPY SEAM.
140  *
141  * The decision order (and why):
142  *   1. Resolve the governor tier (Wave-4 adjudication, I6 floor) and its inclusion policy.
143  *   2. Compute the trio tally from the reviews — this is PURE (no sub-agent calls), so the skip
144  *      decision is made BEFORE any high-tier agent could fire.
145  *   3. INCLUSION TEST: if the round is zero-AXIS-finding, SKIP it — return counts {0,0,0} and the
146  *      demotion stamp without invoking the adjudication layer at all (crit-4). This holds at EVERY
147  *      tier, so even a high-stakes round is skipped when nothing serves the AXIS.
148  *   4. Otherwise delegate to `orchestrateRound` with the tier's inclusion flags. At tier `low` all
149  *      three flags are false ⇒ the spy seam reports {0,0,0}; at `medium`/`high` they are true ⇒ the
150  *      Synthesizer + Judge fire (and debate fires iff there is a cross-origin conflict), so the spy
151  *      seam reports a positive count (the positive control).
152  *
153  * @param {object} o
154  * @param {Function}      o.agent                  the injected agent seam (the spy); required
155  * @param {string|object} o.stakes                 a governor tier OR a declared stakes vector (Wave 4)
156  * @param {Array}         o.reviews                lineage-tagged per-reviewer reviews (the AXIS findings)
157  * @param {number}        [o.round=1]
158  * @param {?string}       [o.northStar=null]
159  * @param {string[]}      [o.priorBlockerIds=[]]
160  * @param {object}        [o.g8={enabled:false}]   G8 fusion options (default inert)
161  * @returns {Promise<object>} { tier, policy, skipped, demoted, counts:{synthesizer,judge,debate}, tally, axisFindingCount, ... }
162  */
163 export async function runGovernedRound({
164   agent,
165   stakes,
166   reviews,
167   round = 1,
168   northStar = null,
169   priorBlockerIds = [],
170   g8 = { enabled: false },
171   // P0 2026-07-25: a TIGHTEN-ONLY band override (LITE triage's includeAdjudication knob).
172   // `false` forces the G9 debate off even where the tier admits it; it can never turn ON
173   // what the tier excludes (the && below), so the governor's cost ceiling is preserved.
174   includeDebate = null,
175 } = {}) {
176   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
177     throw new HaltError('runGovernedRound requires an agent() function', 'pass the injected seam: { agent }');
178   }
179   if (!Array.isArray(reviews)) {
180     throw new HaltError("runGovernedRound requires a reviews[] array (the round's AXIS findings)");
181   }
182 
183   const tier = resolveTier(stakes);
184   const policy = governorPolicy(tier);
185 
186   // PURE pre-flight: the trio tally + AXIS inclusion, computed with NO sub-agent calls. The skip
187   // decision is therefore provably made before any high-tier agent could fire.
188   const tally = tallyFindings(reviews, { priorBlockerIds });
189   const axisFindingCount = axisServingFindings(tally).length;
190 
191   // (3) Inclusion-test enforcement: a zero-AXIS-finding round is skipped/demoted at EVERY tier.
192   if (isZeroAxisFindingRound(tally)) {
193     return {
194       round,
195       tier,
196       policy,
197       skipped: true,
198       demoted: true,
199       reason: ZERO_AXIS_SKIP_STAMP,
200       counts: { synthesizer: 0, judge: 0, debate: 0 },
201       tally,
202       axisFindingCount: 0,
203       reviews,
204     };
205   }
206 
207   // (4) Stakes-scaled adjudication: delegate to the Wave-7 round with the tier's inclusion flags. The
208   // returned `counts` ARE the spy seam — {0,0,0} at low stakes, positive at medium/high.
209   const result = await orchestrateRound({
210     agent,
211     round,
212     northStar,
213     reviews,
214     priorBlockerIds,
215     synthesize: policy.synthesize,
216     judge: policy.judge,
217     debate: policy.debate && includeDebate !== false,
218     g8,
219   });
220 
221   return { tier, policy, skipped: false, demoted: false, reason: policy.reason, axisFindingCount, ...result };
222 }
223

226 export { adjudicateStakes, TIERS, tierAtLeast } from './stakes.mjs';
227 export { orchestrateRound, tallyFindings } from './round.mjs';
